source_lines_after.4: title: "Successive p-multiple layers recover the summands of $C_p^2$ times $C_{p^3}$ times $C_{p^4}^2$"
source_lines_after.35: [L1] Suppose $G\cong\prod_{j<r}C_{p^{e_j}}$ with $e_j\ge1$, and in additive notation write $p^iG=\{p^ig:g\in G\}$. Define $d_i$ by $|p^iG/p^{i+1}G|=p^{d_i}$. Then $$d_i=|\{j:e_j\ge i+1\}|.$$ Consequently, for every $k\ge1$, the number of summands of order $p^k$ is $d_{k-1}-d_k$, so the elementary divisors are intrinsic. ([[lem-successive-p-multiple-quotients-recover-elementary-divisors]]).
